title: Big departments
statementMd:
Which departments have more than three employees? Show the department name and headcount.

Expected columns: `name`, `headcount`.

Tables: `employees`, `departments`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT d.name, COUNT(*) AS headcount FROM employees e JOIN departments d ON d.id = e.department_id GROUP BY d.id, d.name HAVING COUNT(*) > 3;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
